definitions.explanation: A chemical element (Cl) that is a yellowish-green toxic gas with a strong smell. In everyday Japanese, most commonly encountered in the context of water purification (tap water, swimming pools) and cleaning products.

examples.japanese: ⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩素|えんそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I can smell the chlorine from the pool.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水道水|すいどうすい}→水道水：25349_suidousui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{塩素|えんそ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Tap water is disinfected with chlorine.

examples.japanese: {塩素|えんそ}⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}→漂白剤：07035_hyouhakuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}って→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When using chlorine-based bleach, please ensure adequate ventilation.

notes:
USAGE:
In everyday life, {塩素|えんそ} is most commonly discussed in the context of tap water treatment and swimming pool maintenance. The kanji {塩|えん} (salt) reflects that chlorine was historically obtained from salt (⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塩素|えんそ}⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧: chlorine disinfection
- {塩素|えんそ}⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧: chlorine-based
- {塩素|えんそ}⟦{濃度|のうど}→濃度：00325_noudo⟧: chlorine concentration
- ⟦{残留|ざんりゅう}→残留：18406_zanryuu⟧{塩素|えんそ}: residual chlorine
